blogs.title: Promotional Video
blogs.description: One of my most memorable group project because it's my first time going outside of bulsu filming with my fellow classmates, we filmed in bocaue which i've never been to before. After filming the scenes, we decided to go in SM Marilao to hangout and eat together before going home.

blogs.title: Kasanaysayan
blogs.description: This magazine project in Readings in Philippine History is probably the one i got stressed out the most, because we're required to wear "Barong" clothing that is sadly i don't have. Thankfully, Elie's dad have one, which i used taking pictures in Francisco Soc Rodrigo Ancestral House. I also learned while making the content of my magazine that no matter how much we advanced in technologies, we should always values the historical places because it's tied to our identity, culture, and nationalism.

blogs.title: Bahay ni Elie
blogs.description: Vlogging isn't really my thing, but when our professor told us about "Bahay ni Denmark" project, i got somewhat excited because we're gonna budget the minimum wage of 560 pesos living with your fellow kabayan. During filming, i learned a lot about how difficult it would be if it is a real family who are gonna budget. I got to know also my classmates more, because we lived together for 5 days.

blogs.title: CC103 Quiz
blogs.description: Hands-on activity in Programming is not really the most fun thing for a First Year IT Students, especially for me who are struggling badly. Sometimes, i'm thinking if i really chose the right course or i'm just that bad 🙁.

blogs.title: 3D Printing Seminar
blogs.description: We're required to attend and make a reflection in the 3D printing seminar on our Introduction to Computing, It taught me on how rapidly technology is evolving and inspired me to explore more innovative ways of creating and designing. After the seminar, we got a cute 3D cat which we can take.

blogs.title: Dalumatlahi
blogs.description: This project titled "Dalumat Lahi" in the subject RPH is one of my favorite projects. Although it's a bit time-consuming, I still enjoyed it, and that is because I learned about the histories in Bulacan. Back when I was a little boy, I wasn't very appreciative when it came to artifacts and places that have history. But now, I have learned that I should have cared about these things because this is our history, this is our story.

blogs.title: Fluvio-Sense
blogs.description: The flood detection that we have presented for CC 102, called Fluvio-Sense, is one of the innovations that is needed in today's world, especially in our country, the Philippines. It's because, as we are all aware, our country is full of corrupt governments, and one of the results of their doing is a flood that we've always encountered even if there's only light rain. That's why it is a contemporary issue, and the Fluvio-Sense can help mitigate the risk for the people.

blogs.title: MMW Research
blogs.description: The research presentation for MMW that we presented, titled "Software Piracy Among IT Students," is a good start, for me, to experience research presentations in college. Although it's not that hard to do the research, I still enjoyed it because I miss presenting research.

blogs.title: Bahay ni Elie
blogs.description: One of my favorite activities that I did so far is the vlog project that we did for the TCW subject. Basically, this project will let us experience if the minimum wage in Bulacan is enough to sustain the needs of the family. It's my favorite because even if it's draining my pocket, at least somehow, I got to know more about my classmates, Elie and Jonathan, and that's good for me. Additionally, I've learned that the minimum wage is not enough to support and sustain the needs of a family.

blogs.title: PCM Jingle
blogs.description: Singing is one of my hobbies. That's why when our instructor from PCM said that we will create a song and dance, I got excited. I'm so happy that we did this, because somehow, I got to share the little talent that I have.

blogs.title: Promotional Video
blogs.description: This might be my favorite project for this semester. So basically, we filmed a promotional video for the town of Calumpit, and I am the videographer. I like this because being a videographer is one of the things that I want to do in my life. And I did it. Also, I know that the result will be great because I am with the best team in the class.

blogs.title: 3d Printing Seminar
blogs.description: This was a particularly interesting topic for me, especially as I was able to see it hapening in real-time. 3D printing was always something I'd seen online, but being told that it was possible, and within our capabilities in the future made the seminar all the more rewarding and interesting for me.

blogs.title: PCM Jingle
blogs.description: Our project for PCM was... difficult, to say the least. None of us were particularly musically inclined, although lyric creation was something I was generally familliar with. In the end, we finished it and we had a fun time, and a good grade to boot!

blogs.title: Java Quiz
blogs.description: Java. Java. Java... One word that strikes fear into many of 1C-G1's hearts. In truth. It's not as difficult for me as I'm somewhat experienced in coding, ever since the past one and a half years that I've been self studying. In the future I hope that we can all develop our skills nicely.

blogs.title: Bahay ni Elie
blogs.description: 'Bahay ni Elie' or 'Bahay ni Denmark' to be specific, was a nearly one month long project that our group had undertaken to make a video or blog. It was a wonderful opportunity to get to know my other classmates better (Lander and ANgelo), and I can confidently say that it was a very pleasant time with them all. Overall, while it had it's difficulties, I can't say that I didn't enjoy it.

blogs.title: Memes
blogs.description: It's a Meme. Quite Literally. For ARP we had to create a few memes based on socio-economic issues in the Philippines, or common points of argument within society at that time. For this one, I chose to make a caricature of a figurehead for the DPWH, of course, it's made in jest but the situation behind it is quite saddening, don't you think?

blogs.title: ARP Quiz
blogs.description: The Quiz for this time wasn't too difficult, although it wasn't without it's challenges. ARP is a subject that's quite rewarding though, especially when the topics critically analyze aspects of Pilipino culture that Highschool and the lesser years just weren't able to tackle.

blogs.title: NSTP Quiz
blogs.description: NSTP is also a very fun subject, you know? Not only because of our teacher, but also the unique and interesting topics, ranging from the subject of this particular Quiz, such as Volunteerism and Self-Concepts!

blogs.title: Lakbay Bayan
blogs.description: This was another similarly challenging project, especially when we had to literally travel or pursue this 'Lakbay Bayan' in order to see the historical places that we assigned for ourselves. Mine was a church, by the by, and it's one that I've known for  atime. But in the context of this project, I had to think about it not as just my childhood parish, but as a wellspring of history from which I can draw infinite word-soup. In short, lots of yapping.

blogs.title: PCM Midterms
blogs.description: Although technically not a quiz, its impact is too great for me to not mention. This exam was the first time i've felt true despair over my grade, most especially in a zero-grade based system. It is, however, my fault, but it's still a very heartbreaking academic experience.

blogs.title: NSTP Quizzes
blogs.description: Personally speaking, I've found our NSTP quizzes to be fairly achievable to pass in terms of difficulty. To be frank, most of the latest quizzes can be passed by using logic alone, and that's why I somewhat prefer the older quizzes we had, such as the RA 9163 quiz.

blogs.title: PCM Activity
blogs.description: I was always an artist ever since I was a child, and so I get excited whenever we have an activity that involves art. Although the score I got for the drawing was fine, I was still a bit disappointed that I didn't get as high as I hoped it to be. Of course, I got over that now, since I recognized that the content of the drawing itself wasn't that great...

blogs.title: MMW Activity
blogs.description: I've always found math fun despite its difficulty, and I was really happy when I got all of the items correct in this particular activity. This is one of the activities where I had to relearn the module before finally understanding how it works, but it was still fun despite said difficulties.

blogs.title: MMW Quizzes
blogs.description: I enjoyed applying my knowledge to these quizzes, as I get to solve the problems without having to compete with my classmates to answer during lessons haha! There are still instances where I got frustrated over not getting a perfect score, mostly because we can't see what the correct answers are, but undoubtedly I still enjoyed them a lot.

blogs.title: ARP Memes
blogs.description: This activity was about making political memes. I made this video in a day, which was surprising considering how slow Premiere Pro is on my computer.

blogs.title: Bahay ni Elie
blogs.description: This is undoubtedly a project that I've enjoyed a lot, despite the first few days being awkward... For this project, we were tasked with 'living' in a household with only Php560 per day. As you can tell by the title, my house ended up being the location chosen for the project. Having to budget the daily necessities of four people and cooking for them is personally one of my favorite parts of the experience. Overall, it was a memorable experience that resulted in a great video output edited by Lander!

blogs.title: Vier Website
blogs.description: Haha very funny——Making this website was undoubtedly a very tiring experience, mainly because me and Jonathan insisted on making it from scratch... Speaking of which, I want to thank Jonathan for being the main programmer of this, since the rest of us don't have much expertise when it comes to Javascript. Truthfully, it would've been easier and faster if we stuck with templates, but I would'nt deny that making this was a lot of fun.

blogs.title: Calumpit Advert
blogs.description: The project is split into two promotional materials for Calumpit: Flyer and Video. I was a lot more involved in designing the promotional flyer, as I was the main editor, and that experience was... not that great in terms of cramming. Although I did learn to like the output that I designed. As for the video, I contributed to making the drone footage of certain places in Calumpit. Even though it's unrelated, the capturing of the drone footage became a short family trip as well, so it was a nice experience as well.
